bureau: CIASA credit registry (Central Bank of Sudan)
note: The IFC and Arab Monetary Fund's Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015) on Sudan's credit registry: negative information is kept five years once paid, and until paid while it isn't; registered as secondary, the Central Bank of Sudan's own rule not read. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: IFC and Arab Monetary Fund, Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015)
sources.said: whereas negative information is kept ... for five years if all the payments have been made
